sequence: Capture all four inputs before any borrowed callback.
Read the original selected payer's account frontier.
Read and validate the selected asset balance against the same account height.
Collect the existing two request-bound DP observations.
Read the account frontier again and require the same projection.
Use the existing original-checkpoint validator to require exact canonical bytes for the independent original plan and block under the current declared view.
behavior.originalQuoteAndBlock: The original quote, hash, nonce, acknowledgement and complete block are retained. Reuse performs no new quote, material handoff, work search, reassembly, quote refresh or replacement.
behavior.originalBinding: A coherent different nonce/hash packet that the general codec accepts is still rejected against the independent original block and plan.
behavior.balanceAndAccount: Missing selected-asset data and insufficient funds refuse before DP reads. A moved first frontier refuses before balance; a changed final bracket refuses before returning a packet.
behavior.horizon: The original declared p=10, N=2 fixture remains the same block through current Momentum ages 0, 1 and 2; age 3, changed declared runtime context and changed observed price parameter refuse. These are selected synthetic projections, not an inclusion guarantee.
behavior.budgets: One captured shared32-handoff account wire, at most ten admitted three-read cycles. An eleventh cycle refuses before any input inspection or partial read. Existing raw DP transports and method allowlists are unchanged.
behavior.failure: A failure after the first account handoff permanently holds that reader. Busy, held and exhausted checks precede hostile input inspection. Bounded type/size, arity, version, phase and descriptor failures before a handoff do not consume a cycle.
behavior.checkpointText: Primitive text is bounded to 32768 code units and 32768 UTF-8 bytes before a handoff. Incoming text is not parsed by the read adapter or used to select expectations; canonical equality is checked by the existing observed consumer after the current reads.
behavior.compatibility: The two existing factories retain their public surfaces. Selected changed-source controls exercise one legacy validateUnsigned result and one checkpoint-generation result, each with exactly one fresh three-read cycle. This is not a replay or requalification of their entire historical suites.

sourceReview.originalSourcePreservation: The complete inverse of the nine bounded source transformations matched the exact previous Git blob, SHA-256 and retained protected original input before execution; the original protected input was checked again during separate result readback.
sourceReview.fixtureMeaning: Only selected synthetic declarations are reused. No prior test or qualification entry is imported or registered.

AccountInfo lacks a chain identifier and block hash. Two matching frontier projections plus a matching height do not prove freshness, atomicity, ancestry, ABA exclusion, authenticated funds or spendability.

Policy, runtime context, original expectations, public bytes and current observations remain declared DATA. Coherently fabricated DATA can still pass; no provider READY, canonical chain, inclusion, finality or live runtime is authenticated.

Borrowed exchanges are operational trusted capabilities whose owners retain endpoint identity, deadlines, cancellation, unsafe-Promise prehandling and terminal cleanup duties. They are not sandboxed by this module.

Captured intrinsics and unchanged imported validators remain premises. Finite shape/string budgets do not prebound materialization of an enormous own-key set and are not an OS memory, lifetime, process or hostile-code sandbox.
